Entry requirements · 2027 entry

Computer Science at Trinity College Dublin

What Trinity College Dublin asks of applicants to Computer Science for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

Ireland · All Trinity College Dublin courses · Computer Science field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 6 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • Brochure band for this course (Band 2): SAT 1350, GPA 3.4 or ACT 30, GPA 3.4 (unweighted GPA)
  • For 2027 entry SAT/ACT are optional: 'You may submit any SAT/ACT test scores … if you also wish them to be considered'

The brochure (content labelled for 2026 admission) gives SAT/ACT plus GPA bands; the USA page for 2027 entry lets applicants be assessed without standardised tests. Both shown; neither is a guaranteed threshold.

Partly verified21 Oct 2026Trinity Undergraduate Admission Guide for non-EU Students (brochure file named 2027) · Trinity: USA country page
English language
  • Band B (Standard Entry)
  • IELTS Academic 6.5 overall (6.0 in each band)
  • Duolingo 120 overall (100 in each subscore)
  • TOEFL iBT 90 overall (21 each section) before January 2026; 4.5 overall (4.0 each section) after January 2026
  • Cambridge Advanced/Proficiency 180 overall (no score below 170)
  • PTE Academic 69 overall (59 in each section)

GCSE English Language C/5 and other school qualifications are also accepted (English requirements page).

Verified21 Oct 2026Trinity: Computer Science course page · Trinity: English language requirements

Trinity publishes overall competitive admission bands, not per-course offers: this course is Band 2 — AAA from 3 A-levels or AABC from 4 A-levels. Posted scores are minimums and do not guarantee admission. Subject: Grade C in A-Level Mathematics.

Other qualifications
